fact: Following a call launched 20 January 2025, 45 startups from eight regions were selected for Miary Digital's second cohort, incubated 9 to 11 months by three regional incubators (NextA, Orange Digital Center, Zafy Tody).
title: MIARY Digital : 45 nouvelles startups incubées dans la 2e cohorte du programme d'innovation numérique
